name: Stacklist

sources.title: Homepage — link-hub product ('Stop sending links. Send your resource hub.'); free signup at stacklist.com/register
Stacklist Directory — curated 'top curators' profiles (184 listed); 'Interested in getting a profile setup? We'll build it for you for free' → Claim Your Profile → stacklist.app/register

conditions: Building a hub on Stacklist is free (register at stacklist.com/register); a directory profile on stacklistdirectory.com is curated — 'Claim Your Profile' goes through stacklist.app/register and the team builds the profile, so directory inclusion is at their discretion
requirements: Not a product directory — it is a resource-hub tool (cards/stacks/hubs) plus a curated directory of 'curators' (people and brands who share collections)

Directory profiles highlight a curator's favorite products and recommendations across categories (tech, lifestyle, entrepreneurship...); a SaaS would appear as a branded hub/profile, not a listing in a tool catalog
Directory profiles are explicitly framed for AI-engine discoverability ('designed so AI engines can easily surface expert backed lists')
preparation: Brand name, logo/avatar, and a short curator bio
Set of links/resources to organize into cards and stacks (product site, docs, launch posts, socials)
A few 'recommendation' items if positioning as a curator sharing favorite tools
workflow: Create cards (link + notes + tags) and organize them into stacks inside a branded hub
Publish the hub — it lives at a public stacklist.com/<slug> URL
For directory inclusion: use 'Claim Your Profile' on stacklistdirectory.com — the team says they will build the profile for free
watchFor: The old Stacklist startup-tools directory no longer exists — do not expect a 'submit your SaaS' form
Directory is invite/claim-based and small (184 curators); acceptance is not self-serve
A self-made hub page is live immediately but is just a link collection — SEO value is unproven
countsAsLive: A public hub URL (stacklist.com/<slug>) resolves and shows the stacks/cards; for the directory, the profile appears among the listed curators on stacklistdirectory.com
unknowns: Criteria the team uses to accept 'Claim Your Profile' requests
Whether business plans affect public-page branding
